summary: Daily releases retry transient GitHub publish failures, reconcile partial drafts, and accept an explicit verified main tag-release run via --run or workflow dispatch.

replay.detail: Release tooling only; no replay or rebuild changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client changes; existing daily release invocations still select the newest successful main push run.

manual.detail: No action required. Operators may optionally select a successful Fractal tag release push run on main using --run ID or the run workflow input.

recovery.detail: No stored-state migration; failed release creates remove partial drafts before retrying.
